payload.body_they: {{Name}} is willing to change the plan when new information, different needs, or a better way of doing something makes the old choice stop fitting. Other people can be surprised because they often hear about the change after {{Name}} has already spent time questioning what was no longer working. The useful question is what changed. A changed life may need a changed direction. Someone else's expectation of consistency is not, by itself, a reason to keep a choice that no longer fits.
